name: Mortice latch
definition: A latch case sunk into the door edge with a spring latch worked by handles, with no key-thrown bolt.
notes: Howarth lists bolt-through tubular mortice latch, Type Mortice Latch under Locks & Latches; maker not stated

name: Cabinet or cam lock
definition: A small keyed lock fitted to a cupboard door, drawer, locker or mailbox, turning a cam or bolt.
notes: Lockshop Warehouse Cam Locks | Cabinet Locks category; ASEC, Lowe & Fletcher, Yale brands

name: Shutter or garage door lock
definition: A lock made for a roller shutter or up-and-over garage door, such as a bullet lock or shutter lock.
notes: Tessi 6460 oval bullet lock pins roller shutter; sold under Bullet and Shutter Locks category

name: Garage door defender
definition: A lockable steel bar or post fixed in the ground in front of a garage door to stop it being opened.
notes: PJB 302 Garage Defender: ground plate and T-bar blocks up-and-over door, padlock separate

name: Locking bar
definition: A steel bar fixed across a door or gate and secured with one or more padlocks.
notes: Gatemate Shed Locking Bar bolts across door, locked with padlock; sold in Door Locks, Latches & Security

name: Door viewer
definition: A lens fitted through a door so that a caller can be seen from inside without opening it.
notes: ManoMano Door viewers category under Door chains and viewers; brass 200-degree peephole

name: Electronic rodent trap
definition: A battery-powered box trap that kills a mouse or rat by electric shock.
notes: Victor Rat Zapper Ultra: battery-powered electronic rat trap, high-voltage shock

name: Chemical pest repellent
definition: Granules, sachets or a spray of a repellent substance set around a home to keep rodents or other pests away, not applied to the skin.
notes: Victor Rat-A-Way granular scent repellent, poison-free, spread in bands around house perimeter

name: Ledge bird deterrent
definition: A strip, wire coil, slope, gel dish or low-voltage track fixed on ledges and roofs to stop birds landing, other than spikes.
notes: PestFix gel dishes for ledges; Bird Barrier Bird-Coil stainless coil for ledges

name: Bait applicator gun
definition: A plunger gun made to dispense one maker's gel-bait cartridges or syringes.
notes: Maxforce Professional Bait Gun by ENVU holds 30 g gel bait tube; bait applicator sold alone

name: Coving (cornice)
definition: moulding fixed where wall meets ceiling to finish the joint.
notes: Selco Coving category: plaster, polystyrene, polyurethane; Siniat, SuperCove, Gyproc

name: Wood flooring
definition: solid or engineered wood boards laid as a floor (solid or engineered an attribute).
notes: Wood and Beyond Real Wood Flooring dept, engineered oak boards; solid also listed as attribute

name: Vinyl flooring
definition: vinyl planks, tiles or sheet laid as a floor (LVT, click or glue-down; sheet vinyl included).
notes: Travis Perkins Luxury Vinyl Flooring category: Quick-Step Alpha Vinyl, Elka Rigid Plank, ClickLux SPC

name: Flooring underlay
definition: foam, fibre or cork layer laid under laminate, wood or vinyl flooring.
notes: Screwfix Laminate Underlay: 2mm foam roll for floating laminate and wood flooring; unbranded

name: Seesaw
definition: a beam or frame pivoted at the centre with a seat at each end, rocked by two or more children
notes: diy.ie Seesaws category; Plum Premium Wooden Seesaw, beam with seat each end for two children

name: Activity table
definition: a child-height table with built-in toys or play trays (sand, water) for standing play
notes: Wintergreen Toddler Sand & Water Table LC978, all-weather plastic, 18 in high, with plug and lid

name: Ritual spoon or ladle
definition: Spoon or ladle made to pour or offer water, ghee or a sacrament in a rite (achamani, fire-offering ladle, communion spoon named forms).
notes: Bhunes brass achamani/sruk ritual spoon for ghee offering in Homa and Yajna

name: Miniature stupa
definition: Small model of a stupa or chorten made to stand on an altar as a sacred focus, filled with relics or mantras or not (chorten a named form).
notes: Enlightenment Thangka mini stupa (chorten) for altar, gold-plated copper, 19.5 cm; no relic stated

name: Host vessel
definition: Lidded cup, bowl or box made to hold consecrated or unconsecrated hosts (ciborium, pyx, host box named forms).
notes: Eden ciboria category, 56 items from Churchware, CBC Distributors, Charles Farris

name: Alms box
definition: Box, plate or basket made to collect money given as alms, charity or offering in religious practice (church collection box, tzedakah box, saisen box named forms).
notes: 1stDibs tzedakah boxes: charity and poor boxes, several with coin slot; Bier, Sharaby makers

name: Spice box [besamim box]
definition: Small box or tower made to hold fragrant spices smelled in the Havdalah rite (besamim box a named form).
notes: Yair Emanuel Havdalah spice holder for besamim blessing, aluminium, 5 cm tall, spices inside

name: Ritual washing cup
definition: Cup, usually two-handled, made to pour water over the hands in ritual washing (netilat yadayim cup a named form).
notes: Lion of Judah Studio two-handled stainless steel netilat yadayim washing cup, 12.5 cm

name: Bird skull
definition: cleaned real skull of a bird kept as a specimen.
notes: Le Naturaliste cleaned genuine American crow skull specimen, $29.95

name: Reptile skull
definition: cleaned real skull of a reptile (alligator, turtle, snake, lizard) kept as a specimen.
notes: Ward's Science real snake skull, natural bone, professionally cleaned

name: Fish skull
definition: cleaned real skull of a bony fish kept as a specimen (a dried jaw or tooth set is F6.7.2.05).
notes: Skulls Unlimited real piranha skull, natural bone; real pacu skull also listed
